note: YC directory confirms Firecrawl (Summer 2022 batch, Active, San Francisco, same website https://www.firecrawl.dev) matches this provider; founders Caleb Peffer (CEO), Eric Ciarla, Nicolas Silberstein Camara. Firecrawl began as Mendable (AI chat for docs) before pivoting to web-data infrastructure. Raised $14.5M Series A (Aug 2025, led by Nexus Venture Partners) then $75M Series B (Sep 2026, led by Smash Capital) to launch 'Alexandria', a paid data-provider marketplace. Open source (48k+ GitHub stars) with a commercial API/hosted product.
